articleTitle: Deep learning-based medical image analysis with explainable transfer learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Along with the remarkable progress of deep learning-based medical image analysis (DLB-MIA), deep learning models are widely deployed for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD). However, Data scarcity and model interpretability pose noteworthy challenges to DLB-MIA application. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) can be applied in transfer learning to address the aforementioned problems, which makes explainable transfer learning a promising methodology. The utilization of transfer learning combined with XAI techniques is therefore surveyed. The current status of explainable transfer learning is summarized. The application of explainable transfer learning in DLB-MIA is investigated respectively on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformers.

articleTitle: Dropout prediction of MOOCs students based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: With high-quality teaching content and low-threshold learning methods, Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) have drawn hundreds of millions of users. However, the high dropout rate is its weakness compared to offline teaching. To address this problem, this study proposes a convolutional network-based student dropout prediction model, Squeeze Excitation Temporal Convolutional Network (SETCN), to predict learners’ dropout based on student learning clickstream data of MOOCs courses. Firstly, students’ learning record data are converted into users’ learning behavior matrix. Then, local features of the learning matrix are extracted through convolutional techniques. These extracted learning features are then passed into a temporal convolutional network to further refine the data. The students’ temporal learning features are extracted through dilated causal convolution. Finally, a multilayer perceptron is used to derive the dropout prediction for students. Experiments are conducted on public datasets, and the accuracy of the model is 87.9%, which is higher than previous prediction models.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Autonomous Learning Platform Based on Information Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: With the continuous deepening and popularization of modern educational technology, the construction of course teaching based on online educational resources has become the main trend of information and intelligent development in university course teaching. The emergence of Hadoop cloud computing technology has provided a better way to share teaching resources and a good open learning space for students to learn independently. This article starts with the characteristics of information-based teaching, elaborates on the design ideas of an autonomous learning platform based on Hadoop technology, and proposes to integrate HBase and MySQL databases, construct modules such as material library, learning library, test library, and communication library to achieve the functions of the autonomous learning platform, in order to improve the motivation and effectiveness of students’ autonomous learning and promote the level of course informatization construction.

articleTitle: ConRS: Context-response Contrastive Learning for Multi-turn Response Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Multi-turn response selection in retrieval-based dialogue systems aims to select the most appropriate response from several candidates based on a context history, which is still worth the challenge. Nowadays, Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) are superior in handling various tasks in natural language processing (NLP) field. In this paper, we apply BERT to the task, which is formulated as a context–response classification task. However, our preliminary experiments show that BERT pays much attention to the semantic relevance between dialogue context and response, but it is lacking of good ability to learn the temporal dependency between utterances within dialogue context. Moreover, we observe that the representations of dialogue context-response pairs sharing the same context are remarkably similar among each other, which means that they are clustered closely in the vector space, making it difficult for the model to distinguish and classify them. To solve these problems, we propose a general Context-response Contrastive learning framework for multi-turn Response Selection, called ConRS. Specifically, our ConRS learns more utterance-level interactions within the given context and helps to better distinguish positive and negative context-response pairs with high similarity. Furthermore, our ConRS is a self-supervised method tailored to context-response without additional labels, and thus is applicable to other existing models. Experiments on two benchmark datasets including corpus of Chinese and English indicate that our proposed ConRS brings significant improvement for the dialogue models.

articleTitle: Research on User Art Design Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: With the development of computer science and artificial intelligence, graph neural networks are becoming more and more popular in image and visual tasks. This paper discusses the possibility of applying graph neural network to user art design. This study uses a deep learning algorithm based on graph neural networks to generate visual styles by analyzing graphic elements and color schemes used by users in their designs. We developed a graph-based neural network model tha can extract features from user-designed examples and generate new artistic designs. In the experiment, we tested the model and compared it with other design methods based on machine learning. Our experimental results show that our model can produce high quality user art designs with excellent visual quality and variety of styles. In addition, some practical design tools and application examples are provided to demonstrate the potential of graph neural networks in user art design. In conclusion, this study provides useful reference and enlightenment for the application of graph neural network in user art design.

articleTitle: Web news analysis based on web crawler technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Since the concept of big data was put forward, Internet data has received wide attention and data mining objects, and network news data occupies half of the Internet data. With the characteristics of rapid dissemination, short exposure time and containing netizens’ opinions, the intrinsic value contained in web news is self-evident. In this paper, we use relevant web crawler technologies and algorithms to build an automated collection of online media news data and structured storage. The Chinese word separation algorithm and Chinese similarity analysis algorithm are used to summarize and organize the system, and the system is tested to check the validity and accuracy of the system design. According to the test results, the system can collect and organize information more accurately, so the system results are valid and can be used as a tool for analyzing online news in the future.

articleTitle: Traditional martial arts boxing recognition based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Recognizing traditional Chinese martial arts punches in the video provides a new technical tool for martial arts education and research. There is no direct method to recognize traditional martial arts kung fu. We propose a fast and effective solution to address the low resolution of the video in the process of recognition and the fact that having similar stances can lead to misjudged kung fu. Firstly, adding SPD-Conv to the backbone network of yolov5s can improve the recognition accuracy in low-resolution videos. Secondly, an attention mechanism module that reinforces useful features is added to the C3 module to extract target features and improve recognition accuracy fully. The experimental findings demonstrate that the suggested approach can identify eight conventional fist styles of martial arts, namely Bagua Palm, Bajiquan, Taijiquan, Maze Boxing, Mantis Boxing, Tongbei Boxing, Form Yi Boxing, and Wing Chun Boxing. Compared with target detection algorithms such as YOLOv4 and YOLOv5s, it performs better and can effectively handle the behavioral recognition of actors.

articleTitle: Establishment of teaching system for online tourism management major in colleges and universities based on computer multimedia
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Compared with traditional educational information technology, virtual reality technology has the characteristics of situational, interactive, measurable and multi-dimensional. This is of great value to the undergraduate teaching of tourism management, which attaches importance to the simulation of tourism experience and the planning of tourism field. It can meet the functional requirements of dynamic, real-time and interactive in the process of teaching and experimental training. The system developed adopts the latest ASP.NET technology based on computer and information science. The functional modules of multimedia and network technology are designed. The research and development of multimedia network teaching management system in colleges and universities is a new symbol of the application of computer and information science in colleges and universities. The main functions of undergraduate teaching of tourism management specialty based on computer multimedia tourism are as follows: multimedia information query, tourism spatial information processing, tourism geographic environment simulation, online tourism geographic information system, tourism expert system and virtual scenic spots. The application of virtual reality technology in tourism management practice teaching system can enhance teaching effect, cultivate practical ability, strengthen teacher-student interaction and enhance innovation consciousness.

articleTitle: Cross-modal sentiment analysis based on Transformer and image-text collaborative interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: In order to make full use of the interaction between images and texts, improve the extraction effect of each modal feature, and improve the accuracy of multi-modal classification, this paper proposed a sentiment classification method based on Transformer and image-text collaborative interaction. In this model, the image and text features are extracted based on Transformer, and the bidirectional long short-term memory network and attention mechanism are introduced while the text features are extracted, and the Vision Transformer is used to obtain the visual features of the image. Then, a fusion method based on information adaptive weight adjustment is designed, which adjusts the weight parameters of model fusion in real time according to the feature information of image and text to perform weighted fusion. Experiments show that the model improves the accuracy and F1 value.

articleTitle: The Application of Big Data Algorithm in the Analysis of the Effectiveness of College Students’ Online Patriotism Education
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: This article explores the application of big data algorithms in the effectiveness analysis of online patriotism education for college students. With the rapid development of the internet, college students are increasingly accessing information and participating in social activities through the internet. Online patriotism education has become an important way to cultivate college students’ national consciousness and patriotic emotions. However, how to evaluate the effectiveness of online patriotic education has always been a challenge. This study is based on big data algorithms and collects a large amount of online data and user behavior data to analyze the situation of college students’ exposure, participation, and feedback on online patriotic education on online platforms. First, data mining technology and natural language processing technology are used to capture and analyze the patriotic education content of college students on social media, news websites, online education platforms and other online channels. By analyzing a large amount of online data, it is possible to gain a deeper understanding of the degree and effectiveness of patriotic education received by college students on online platforms. At the same time, big data algorithms can identify key influencing factors and correlation laws, providing scientific basis for formulating effective online patriotic education strategies and measures.

articleTitle: Application of face recognition in university student management system based on improved YOLOv4tiny algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Since the novel coronavirus spread globally two years ago, epidemic prevention and control has become an important task in university management. In this paper, we use the YOLOv4-tiny algorithm for face recognition of students in the student management system of colleges and universities. This paper constructs a more accurate target detection algorithm based on YOLOv4-tiny to quickly detect faces in various complex situations and achieve more accurate and fast identity verification. It realizes the accurate management of students and improves the efficiency in the epidemic supervision of students in universities.

articleTitle: ChatGPT research hotspots, frontiers, and trends - Analysis of WOS data based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: This article examines the academic area, research subjects, and development progression of current ChatGPT research using the Web of Science (WoS) database and the visual bibliometric program CiteSpace. It has been discovered that ChatGPT has received a significant amount of attention from the academic community since its introduction, and studies on ChatGPT have focused on the issues of “technical optimization,” “practical application,” and “ethical risks,” which have obvious similarities and correlations. Combining the phases of ChatGPT research might help to understand the research landscape and the evolution of ChatGPT, and future ChatGPT research should continue to broaden research perspectives, update research procedures, and improve communication and collaboration.

articleTitle: Robot path planning based on improved A* algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: The A* algorithm has been widely employed in the automatic navigation of mobile robots. However, the traditional A* algorithm faces challenges in handling complex environments and large-scale maps due to high computational complexity, large memory requirements, and suboptimal performance under real-time constraints. To address these issues and enhance search efficiency, reduce memory usage, and improve path quality, an improved A* algorithm based on a 24-neighborhood search is proposed. Firstly, a safety strategy is introduced to improve path safety by setting appropriate buffer zones and disabling unsafe search. Secondly, the 24-neighborhood is reduced to eight search intervals according to the orientation of the destination, which reduces the number of turning points and improves search speed. Then, the evaluation function is improved by adding an exponentially weighted turning cost, which speeds up the search process and reduces the total turning angle. Finally, the modified A* algorithm is simulated multiple times using Python, and the results show improvements in planning time, number of turning points, path safety, and total turning angle.

articleTitle: Travel Region Prediction based on Spatio-Temporal Adjacency-Aware Enhanced Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing taxi travel region prediction research is difficult to pay attention to the proximity between regions and ignore the time dependence, in order to fully mine the historical trajectory data to accurately predict the travel region, a taxi travel region prediction model based on Spatio-temporal adjacency perception enhanced Transformer (STAATN) was proposed l Adjacency Aware Transformer Network). The encoder dynamically updates the information of each node by stacking the local region feature information, and uses its temporal characteristics to update the information of each node. At the same time, the attention mechanism with spatial characteristics is fused. In the decoder, a new adaptive distillation mechanism is designed to input the fused results into the decoder to generate the prediction results in turn. Experiments were carried out on the public Data set TLC Trip Record Data. The results show that the prediction effect of STAATN model is better than that of the original model. In terms of Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), the proposed model was reduced by 0.2, 0.73 and 1.4% respectively compared with the model before improvement.

articleTitle: Practice teaching exploration of Database System based on Huawei Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: According to the current teaching practice of traditional database system practice, this paper analyzes the problems of high one-time investment cost, regular maintenance of software and hardware, spatiotemporal handwriting, and lack of comprehensive training in database system practice courses. It introduces the design and implementation process of the database system practice teaching based on Huawei Cloud, and takes the real teaching practice as an example to illustrate the effectiveness of the integration of Huawei Cloud Platform into the database system practice teaching.

articleTitle: Research Progress and Analysis of Information Education Abroad: Based on CiteSpace Graph Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Objective: To understand the current situation and research hotspots of network informatization education since 2010, and to provide reference for domestic and foreign scholars’ research on network informatization education.Methods: Using “Online Education”, “online learning”, “Network Informatization Education “The Web of Science (WOS) database was searched from January 1, 2010 to January 1, 2023, and CiteSpace 5.8 R2 software was applied to visualize and analyze the annual number of articles, co-occurrence and clustering of keywords.Results: A total of 3818 articles were included, and the number of articles from 2010 to 2023 showed a fluctuating upward trend, with the largest number of articles in 2022; the high-frequency keywords were students, medical education, impact, knowledge, care, online, health, etc; The clustering mapping shows that all keywords are clustered into 9 categories, with a total of 15 keywords involved in co-occurrence; the research content is mainly focused on 3 aspects such as continuing education, physical activity, and knowledge.Conclusion: More attention is paid to online education research, the key research directions of physical activity and knowledge, and continuing education is the hot spot of research concern; indicators online education is still the mainstream research trend, and more attention is paid to higher online education than primary education.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Chatbots in the Field of Education: A Bibliometric Analysis Using VOSviewer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: ChatGPT has achieved remarkable success, leading to significant research attention on Chatbots in the field of education (CE) due to their immense potential and impact. This study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the research directions in CE by conducting bibliometric and visualization analyses using VOSviewer software. A total of 575 CE-related publications were retrieved from the Web of Science database for analysis. The findings reveal a significant and rapid growth trend in CE research since 2018, with the United States leading in publication quantity (159 publications). The study explores productive institutions, author collaboration networks, highly cited literature, and influential authors in the CE-Chatbots domain. Six primary research directions emerged: E-learning and its impact on education, computer-supported collaborative learning in education, effective communication in online education, the ethical implications of artificial intelligence in education, chatbots for enhanced learning experiences, and language learning during the COVID-19 pandemic. Building upon these findings, the study proposes relevant recommendations in terms of student engagement, teacher involvement, optimization of the teaching process, and academic integrity.

articleTitle: A Technique for Digitizing and Reviewing Video Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: The traditional video content analysis technology has been unable to meet the demand for management and retrieval of massive video data. This paper proposes a technique for digitizing and reviewing video resources, whose functions are divided into two parts: one is to convert video texts into digital lecture notes; the other is to complete a quick search in video resources by specifying keywords, and automatically locate and generate corresponding video clips. It adopts digital technologies such as artificial intelligence to digitize video resources, and can help education practitioners to complete text extraction and intelligent review.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi-interactive Intelligent Teaching in Exhibition Design Courses
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: We discuss the design and implementation of multi-faceted interactive intelligence instruction for exhibition design courses. Our intent is threefold: 1) adapting the new humanities and social sciences to the undergraduate training requirements of applied higher education institutions. 2) combining course characteristics, teaching processes and teaching objectives, and 3) developing a smart teaching model for the curriculum that use “Chaoxing Xuexitong” intelligent terminals. Because successful implementation requires both leadership from teachers and a collaborative effort from students, we review the development process of online teaching to identify the advantages of online teaching platform construction. We also consider how teaching organization and information, and the design perspective can be optimized using the Chaoxing classroom teaching platform. This mode of delivery yields benefits via the optimization of teaching effectiveness while providing a model that can be used to explore intelligent teaching of information technology in exhibition design courses.

articleTitle: WORDLE game Outcome Prediction based on PSO-LSTM Neural network model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: The mathematical laws in Wordle are worth studying. In order to study the number of Wordle players in the future, the optimized time series prediction model under partition processing was established for the distribution of the number of players and the percentage of future completion. Combined with the visualization analysis of the number of players, the applicability of ARIMA model was processed. The original data was collected into the partition data set of 300 days of historical data, and the model after training was used for prediction. Using percentage error and variance to evaluate, the number of players in the next March 1, 2023 is 36,540, the fluctuation range is: [20432,42381], and the increase is increased. In order to predict the percentage distribution of customs clearance in the future, the word is separated by letters, the data set of letters is collected by grids, and the PSO-LSTM model is established to analyze the letter index for prediction. Fitness was calculated and visualized. It was found that RMSE predicted by training set was 0.65938 and RMSE predicted by test set was 0.57512, indicating that the model was accurate. The separate prediction of EERIRE shows that the minimum clearance rate is 0.2% for the first clearance, and the maximum clearance rate is 36% for the fourth clearance.

articleTitle: A Review on Text-based CAPTCHA Breaking Based on Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: The security of cyberspace has become a global common concern, with websites and information systems facing significant threats. Text-based CAPTCHAs, widely implemented by websites, play a crucial role in preventing illicit attacks by robots and crawlers. However, in recent years, various breaking methods, particularly those based on deep learning, have emerged. This paper conducts a comprehensive investigation into the resistance mechanisms of text-based CAPTCHAs, analyzing their technical aspects in CAPTCHA design. Subsequently, we explore the recognition procedures of CAPTCHA utilizing deep learning models and compare representative algorithms developed in recent years. Finally, we evaluate the positives and negatives of different cracking algorithms and summarize our findings.

articleTitle: Research on the design of children’s picture-looking and speaking system based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: With the increasing number of images, the machine and describes the image content in image text with people’s reading habits has become an important research content in the field of artificial intelligence. The research goal of this paper is to design and realize a picture speaking system using image text description technology, to apply artificial intelligence technology in the field of education and to assist early childhood education. To achieve this goal, this paper studies the image text description technology.

Author Keywords: young children look at pictures and speak

articleTitle: Progressive Gradual Practice Teaching Design of Information Security Based on OBE
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: The paper focuses on the teaching design of information security experiment course. In order to improve the efficiency of practical teaching, the progressive gradual practice teaching design of information security based on OBE(Outcome Based Education) was put forward. Taking “ability-oriented education” as the main idea, focusing on the cultivation of two abilities of students which are the “ability to recognize security threats” and the “ability to perfect security protection”, two types of practical subjects of “verification” and “exploration” are gradually set up at different levels. At mean time, ideological and political elements are integrated in the teaching process in a timely manner. The teaching practice shows that the implementation of this scheme effectively improves the teaching effect.

articleTitle: The Research and Construction of the AI-Based Knowledge Graph in Multi-Dimensional Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: With the development of deep learning and the knowledge graph, artificial intelligence has had a significant influence on the area of education as a result of the rapid growth of this age, which has profoundly altered human productivity and daily life. The university is undergoing a digital transformation. The essence of the knowledge graph is the knowledge base of the semantic network. Using natural language processing (NLP) technology, the university can construct a knowledge graph. Integrating knowledge graphs and deep learning has become one of the most important aspects of further improving the effect of deep learning. The solution to knowledge graph processing data is “algorithm, totalization, and implementation”. The key technologies of constructing knowledge graphs in multi-dimensional data mainly focus on knowledge ontology definition, knowledge representation, knowledge modeling, knowledge extraction, knowledge fusion, knowledge processing, knowledge computing, and other technologies. The research in this paper shows that the RDF model and algorithm of the knowledge graph have application prospects in multi-dimensional data.

articleTitle: The construction of an open language learning platform based on the Internet context
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: This paper is a ruthless study and exploratory analysis of the construction of a learning platform based mainly on the Internet’s big data context. The first aspect discusses how to build a complete learning platform. The second part analyses some of the problems encountered in the process of building and using this learning platform as well as the positive learning evaluation and learning effects brought about in the process of using it. Students can plan their language learning based on their performance in the classroom and can use the language learning platform to correct and amend any deficiencies in their offline learning. Students’ behavioural data makes the right feedback and promotes the science of process assessment in the IT classroom. Throughout the research innovation, the establishment of a big data technology learning platform with language learning this is also a relatively new research approach. Therefore, this study hopes to establish a process evaluation system for primary school IT classrooms based on an online learning platform so that process evaluation can promote students’ learning efficiency and learning motivation.

articleTitle: Portmanteau Word Detection Based on LD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: The advancement of Internet technology has promoted the development of network language, and the vocabulary in the traditional English dictionary can no longer be sufficient for on-trend expressions. People need new words to describe more precisely. The portmanteau word, or the lexical blend, is a common way to create new words from existing ones. This research develops an algorithm to identify whether an English word is a lexical blend and successfully applies it to real-world datasets.

articleTitle: Operation Effectiveness Evaluation of a New Engineering Vehicle Based on Grey-AHP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: In order to accurately evaluate the operational effectiveness of a new engineering vehicle, the main factors affecting the operational effectiveness of the new engineering vehicle in the corps were analyzed, from engineering work capability, motor ability, communication ability, protective ability and system adaptability five aspects constructing evaluation index system, the gray analytic hierarchy process (Grey-AHP) is adopted to establish the evaluation model, combined with the analytic hierarchy process(AHP) and expert evaluation method to determine index weight at all levels, the use of grey number and the albino function, automatically calculating results by the C language and the Python programming, The evaluation results are analyzed and fed back, and suggestions are put forward for the operational application and equipment improvement of engineering reconnaissance vehicle.

articleTitle: Design of Customized Corpus Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Corpora play a critical role in the fields of linguistics and natural language processing, but many available corpora lack professional standards and are too general. Thus, creating customized corpora that meet specific needs is essential. In this paper, we propose a method for creating corpora using big data technology. The method involves collecting a large amount of data from the internet, utilizing Hadoop as the basic framework, using HBase as the data warehouse, performing data cleaning, filtering, and standardized structural processing, and finally conducting classification and archiving. The data is then imported into a relational database to create a flexible and customizable corpus system.

articleTitle: Current research on personalized teaching system based on CiteSpace visual analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: With the massive popularity of online learning, the development of personalized teaching systems to meet the different needs of learners has become a widespread concern for researchers in the face of abundant online teaching resources and the diversity of learners. Based on the bibliometrics, this paper has used CiteSpace to examine the 473 SCI articles on the topic of “Personalized teaching system” from 2005 to 2023 in the Web of Science Core Repository (WOS). “This paper analyzes the basic features, research hotspots and research trends in the field of personalized teaching system by visualizing 473 SCI and SSCI documents from 2005 to 2023 in the Web of Science (WOS).It show that scholars in this field have not yet formed a high degree of close cooperation. Keyword co-occurrence clustering shows that system, education, intelligent tutoring systems, and technology are the hot topics of research; after 2019, higher education, personalized recommendation, deep learning, artificial intelligence become the frontier topics of Personalized teaching system research, showing the development trend of integration of artificial intelligence technology and education teaching. Finally, we constructed a multi-level structured personalized teaching system model Learning-Map through ISM.

articleTitle: A Double Diagonal Ratio Metric for Tiny Object Detection in Aerial Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of deep learning and the maturity of object detection technology, unprecedented progress has been made in aerial image object detection tasks. But for detecting tiny objects with little pixel information and easily confused with the background, the general-purpose detectors still do not achieve good performance. Through analysis, we found that, in addition to the defects of the tiny objects themselves, the sensitivity of the most commonly used IoU-based metric to tiny objects is one of the main reasons for the poor detection performance. Therefore, we design a new metric, Double Diagonal Ratio (DDR), which alleviates the poor performance by using a first power line segment ratio instead of a second power area ratio. Note that, DDR is simple in design and can be easily embedded into almost all detectors assignment, non-maximal suppression, and loss function modules to replace IoU. In addition, DDR does not introduce additional hyper-parameters and has stronger robustness. We evaluate our metric on the AI-TOD dataset, and extensive experimental results show that DDR significantly affects the detector performance improvement, especially on tiny objects.

articleTitle: Demand forecasting method of online music teaching in Colleges and Universities Based on Fuzzy Cognitive Map
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: Online music education is unprecedented, and online music teaching has become a new trend in the development of music education. However, the current teaching quality evaluation system has not been formed to adapt to the online music classroom, a considerable number of online music classes still use the traditional evaluation standards of offline music courses. Based on this, this paper studies the demand prediction method of College Online Music Teaching Based on fuzzy cognitive map, and the establishment of music online teaching evaluation system has become the decisive factor for the sustainable development of online music education. This paper constructs the online music teaching evaluation system from three aspects of foundation, process and result, constructs the music online teaching quality evaluation system from four aspects of organization strategy, goal strategy, support strategy and feedback strategy, and puts forward the improvement strategy of online music teaching evaluation system, so as to improve the quality and effect of online music teaching evaluation, It lays a theoretical foundation for better online music teaching.

articleTitle: Development and Application of an English Corpus System Based on Java Web
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: To address the present challenges and issues in the study of language corpora and linguistic features, this paper will employ tools including native language search, collocation analysis, segment extraction, and part-of-speech tagging to enhance phrase research capabilities. Our aim is to refine algorithms, boost processing speed and efficacy, and thus support the field of corpus linguistics in a superior manner. By merging current semantic analysis techniques and undertaking further refinements, we aim to offer a comprehensive platform for linguistic feature investigation. We also plan to deploy database technologies to create an English corpus and augment our comparative samples to enrich research diversity.

articleTitle: Design of a Physical Simulation Teaching Aid System for Industrial Internet Talent Training
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of digital economy, the accelerated transformation of industrial digitalization, and the rapid iteration of digital industrialization, the shortage of digital talents has restricted the development of China’s digital economy, so the cultivation of industrial digital talents has become the top priority of China’s digital construction tasks. To address the current situation of lack of teaching aids in China’s digital talent training, this paper takes the rice supply chain as a typical object and designs a set of physical simulation teaching aids system for digital talent training, which includes model hardware, real-time detection and control system and remote data interaction platform based on Identity Resolution Platform for the Industrial Internet of Things. Based on this, the paper combines digital twin technology to build a digital twin teaching and research platform for the rice supply chain, including physical simulation teaching aids, digital twin system and a comprehensive practical training course, to help China’s digital talent training strategy.

articleTitle: Design Discipline Teaching Reform and Innovation under Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: With the rapid development of technologies such as the Internet of Things, blockchain, artificial intelligence, big data, machine learning and automation, web 3.0 is bound to be a decentralized era. The traditional way of teaching art is unable to unify theory and practice, and can no longer respond to the needs of talents in the digital age. The new liberal arts building, which was started by the Ministry of Education, aims to improve the university teaching reform model and advance the comprehensive integration of contemporary technological education with traditional Chinese liberal arts majors. In this context, the article uses blockchain technology and integrates it into the teaching of design subjects in a targeted manner. The “incentive mechanism” and “distributed ledger” features of blockchain technology are utilized to support student learning, design motivation, and design work intellectual property protection. Implement theory and technology fundamentally to prepare pupils to become comprehensive Talent.

articleTitle: The Construction of the Academic Honesty Education Model for Undergraduate Students in Online Education Base on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Distance Learning (CEDL)
abstract: The national colleges and universities’ large-scale application of online education during the Covid-19. Academic dishonesty frequently occurs, leading to society’s attention to the problem of academic honesty. As a vital reserve force of academic talents, undergraduate students should pay more attention to their academic honesty. Nowadays, undergraduate students’ academic consciousness is weak, and their academic dishonesty is gradually showing new characteristics and problems under the large-scale application of online education. In the face of increasingly frequent and diverse academic dishonesty problems, various academic misconduct detection systems supported by computer technology have played a positive role in solving the problem of academic dishonesty among undergraduate students. We must study and think about improving undergraduate students’ academic honesty education with the development of online education combined with computer technology. This paper probes into the problems existing in undergraduate students’ academic honesty education under online education. Then it constructs the academic honesty education model from undergraduate students themselves, legal system, academic honesty training, and academic honesty supervision management mechanism, four aspects of standardizing undergraduate students’ academic behavior and forming an excellent academic moral atmosphere in colleges and universities.
